# TOOLING.md — agent tool routing (generated by /setup-agent-tooling; regenerate, don't hand-edit)

Profile: **app** · updated 2026-08-15

For every job below, the named tool IS the way to do it. If it errors: run the doctor (`python3 ~/.claude/agent-tooling/doctor.py --repo .`), fix the connection, retry. Escalate to Johan only when the doctor can't fix it.

## Routing

- Expo/EAS (builds, OTA updates, TestFlight crashes, store reviews): Expo MCP + `eas` CLI. Docs/upgrade/router questions: expo skills.
- Auth (Clerk): clerk skills + clerk CLI. HARD RULE: development-instance keys only; production Clerk changes stay manual.
- Subscriptions (Adapty): `adapty` CLI (apps/products/paywalls/placements) + Analytics Export API. Flow Builder canvas and A/B lifecycle are dashboard-only; vary paywalls via remote-config JSON (GET-merge-PUT).
- Errors/crashes: Sentry MCP (search issues, analyze with Seer).
- Product analytics: PostHog MCP (insights, SQL, flags, experiments).
- App Store Connect (metadata, pricing, IAP, TestFlight, review replies, sales reports): `asc` CLI (+ `asc web` for privacy labels / app records). Native build/test/simulators: XcodeBuildMCP. E2E: Maestro (agent drives sim, commits YAML flow as regression test). Submission step has ONE owner: `eas submit`.
- Database (Drizzle/Postgres on VPS): ssh + psql / drizzle-kit via project scripts. DB is VPS-local — no MCP path.
- VPS: Postiz box = `ssh johan-vps` (Azure, Docker in ~/postiz). Reform server = AWS via Reform.pem. Manage via ssh + docker compose + az/aws CLIs — never a cloud web console.

## Fallback ladder
MCP tool → same service's CLI → doctor → ask Johan. Dashboards listed in the block-hook have full CLI/MCP coverage; the browser adds nothing there.
